The '''Board of Directors''' was the governing body of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], led by [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Siin Suub]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Sullustan Council]] was forcibly dissolved, and SoroSuub installed as rulers of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], the Board of Directors became the supreme [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] authority.<ref name="Proclamation" />
